{{< drawing data/pythagoras.json auto=true >}}

{{< drawing data/quadratic.json auto=true >}}

Two stopping points, so three segments. The first plays by itself (auto=true), then one click for the square root and one for the denominator.

{{< drawing data/euler.json >}}

::: notes
Two stopping points and no auto: the slide starts blank and each click writes the next piece.
:::
